summary: Repaired configure.ac and the Makefile.am files and isodur.pc.in, and added an m4/ placeholder. Version now comes from VERSION, the libtool version-info comes from the m4_define lines, symbols are exported by regex, and libm is linked. The data directory is compiled in from $(pkgdatadir), and the .pc paths come from configure. The BUILD_TOOL conditional and the durfmt link with DESTDIR, uninstall and install paths are fixed, and dist files are completed. Default, --disable-shared, lib64 with another datarootdir, --disable-tool and changed VERSION/interface builds, make check, distcheck and a tarball rebuild were tested. With another VERSION, only the tests/cases/version case fails, because it hardcodes 1.4.0.
